title: Make the billsplit CI gates green before touching billsplit
objective: billsplit CI was already failing on main at 6713ef3: flutter analyze --fatal-infos exited 1 with four unnecessary_unawaited issues, and dart format --set-exit-if-changed exited 1 on three test files left unformatted by an earlier split commit. Both are steps in .github/workflows/billsplit-ci.yml. This change fixes exactly those two gates and nothing else, so that the platform-directory deletion that follows can be verified as green-to-green rather than red-to-red.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze --fatal-infos exits 0 in billsplit/ (was exit 1, 4 issues)
dart format --set-exit-if-changed . exits 0 in billsplit/ (was exit 1, 3 changed files)
flutter test still reports exactly 60 passing tests, the same count as at HEAD - proving the unawaited() removals did not alter navigation behaviour in the widget tests
No lint suppression, no analysis_options exclusion, and no lowered threshold is used to reach any of the above
out_of_scope: Deleting billsplit/windows, macos, ios or linux - that is the next commit, with its own contract
Any change to billsplit behaviour, UI, or test assertions
The 45 bucket_catch eslint errors and the usage_report split work, both tracked separately in this session
verifier: cd billsplit && flutter analyze --fatal-infos && dart format --set-exit-if-changed . && flutter test - the first three steps of .github/workflows/billsplit-ci.yml. Each was run before and after the change and the exit codes are recorded in docs/superpowers/evidence/billsplit-ci-green-2026-08-17.json.
